title: Design System: Oren Segal Portfolio — Utility Cutaway

body.purpose: All prose: About, project descriptions, Contact intro, flight-log copy.

label.purpose: Project-detail sub-headers (Problem/Decisions/Outcome/Key features/Impact/Tech stack) only. Unchanged this session.

meta-mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono, confined to small machine-sourced facts: Hero proof chips, flagship chart labels, the litmus mutant table, cited tier output, Checks PR refs, last-push dates. Never prose or headings.

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8x8 SVG static data indicator, not a hover/active state signal. Filled accent circle at rest on the Hero availability line; the outlined ink-faint state is kept but not rendered today.
components.html: <svg width="8" height="8" viewBox="0 0 8 8"><circle cx="4" cy="4" r="4" fill="#8fd6a8"/></svg>
components.css: /* filled: fill #8fd6a8, r=4. outlined: fill none, stroke #7a7d7f, stroke-width 1.25, r=3.25 */

components.name: Proof Chip
components.description: Hero-only square-cornered mono chip with a 1px line border and no fill, linking to the flagship that backs its number. Each chip is a number already stated in the profile README or on the site.
components.css: .ds-proof-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #232527; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: #9a9d9f; } .ds-proof-chip:hover { border-color: #4b7a5d; color: #8fd6a8; }

components.name: Flagship
components.description: rootcause, litmus, cited in fixed order. Title link, one line on what it is, one number (text-3xl tabular) opening its finding sentence, Repo plus write-up/result/PR link, and a visual drawn in code from a committed result file named in its figcaption. Two columns at sm, stacked on mobile, hairline-divided.
components.html:
rootcause

25x apart in cost per solved incident
components.css: .ds-flagship { display: grid; gap: 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid #232527; padding: 40px 0; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-flagship { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.15fr; } } .ds-flagship-number { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; color: #f2f1ea; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Inline Text Link
components.description: In-sentence link with a dim underline at rest that brightens on hover — Hero's GitHub-percentage link, project 'source' links.
components.html: 42% of it open source, verifiable on GitHub
components.css: .ds-link-inline { color: #f2f1ea; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #4b7a5d; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 0.15s, text-decoration-color 0.15s; } .ds-link-inline:hover, .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: #8fd6a8; } .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Link
components.description: Standalone call-to-action link with a trailing arrow icon that nudges on hover — 'See the work'.
components.html: See the work
components.css: .ds-link-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #f2f1ea; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-link-action-icon { transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-link-action:hover .ds-link-action-icon { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-link-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top navigation — dim by default, brightens on hover, no underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #9a9d9f; font-size: 14px; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f2f1ea; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contact Channel Row
components.description: Icon + label link row in Contact, py-4 (16px) interval; icon and text transition to accent together as one hover target (interaction-state accent, not the utility-line active state).
components.html: orenssegal@gmail.com
components.css: .ds-channel-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #232527; padding: 16px 0; } .ds-channel-row:first-child { padding-top: 0; } .ds-channel-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-channel-icon { color: #7a7d7f; transition: color 0.15s; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-channel-label { color: #f2f1ea; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-channel-row:hover .ds-channel-icon, .ds-channel-row:hover .ds-channel-label { color: #8fd6a8; }

components.name: Section Spine
components.description: Every full-width home section wraps its content in a left-bordered hairline spine. The rotated DepthTag that used to sit in the spine's margin was removed on 2026-11-05 (clipped on mobile).
components.css: .ds-section { border-top: 1px solid #232527; padding: 96px 16px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-section { padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; } } .ds-spine { position: relative; max-width: 768px; margin: 0 auto; border-left: 1px solid #232527; padding-left: 20px; }

components.name: Detail Sub-header Label
components.description: Uppercase, tracked sub-header scoped to the project-detail page only (Problem/Decisions/Outcome/Key features/Impact/Tech stack) — not a general kicker. Unchanged this session.
components.css: .ds-detail-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #7a7d7f; }

narrative.northStar: Utility Cutaway — the page is a literal underground utility cross-section; what a visitor sees on the surface sits on real strata of infrastructure work beneath it
narrative.overview: The page is staged as an underground utility cross-section: the near-black ground (#0a0b0c) is depth and every home section (Hero, Work, Checks, More projects, About, Contact) is a border-l hairline spine. The rotated depth labels were removed on 2026-11-05 because they clipped on mobile and read as broken. The Hero states one finding from the rootcause benchmark with three mono proof chips. Work shows three flagships (rootcause, litmus, cited), each with one number and a visual drawn from committed results. Checks lists three PRs where a check proved less than it claimed. Every other project is one table row with its live CI badge and last-push date; build logs are on detail pages only. Accent green marks interaction state and the filled StatusDot only. No fabricated metrics: every number traces to a committed file or the live GitHub API.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#0a0b0c) read as literal depth; every home section is a border-l border-line pl-5 spine, with no margin label
Space Grotesk for every heading and sentence; JetBrains Mono only for small machine-sourced facts (chips, chart labels, mutant table, tier output, PR refs, dates)
Accent green (#8fd6a8) has two jobs: interaction state and the filled StatusDot
Flagship visuals are inline SVG or HTML tables built from committed result files, each captioned with its source
One motion curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) drives Hero's entrance

rules.name: The Accent-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent green is spent on exactly two things: interaction (hover/focus/selection) and the filled status dot as a binary data affirmative. It is never a background fill, never a static heading color, and there is no second accent hue.

rules.name: The Scoped Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono renders only machine-sourced facts: numbers, ids, tool output, dates. Never a heading, a sentence of prose, or above text-sm.

rules.name: The One Rendered Surface Rule
rules.body: Exactly one background tone is painted on the page (panel, #0a0b0c). Depth is expressed by hairline dividers and the border-l spines, never by a second background fill, a shadow, or a blur.

dos: Do confine mono to machine-sourced facts, always small. Do not use mono for a heading or a sentence of prose.
Do use border-l border-line pl-5 for any new full-width home section.
Do spend accent green only on the two named jobs (interaction, filled status dot).
Do draw any new visual from a committed result file and name that file in its caption.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: app/globals.css collapses all animation/transition durations to near-zero.
donts: Don't treat StatusDot's resting accent fill as a general license for static accent color elsewhere — it is scoped to genuine binary data indicators.
Don't use mono for decoration; mono marks content type, color marks state.
Don't add a second background/surface tone, a shadow, a blur, or a gradient.
Don't box content in bordered cards; the proof chip is the only bordered element.
Don't add a category filter/toggle to the home page.
Don't bring back the rotated depth labels or replace them with a horizontal eyebrow/kicker above a heading.
Don't treat panel.face (#121315, added to tailwind.config.ts this session) as an active token — zero usages across .tsx/.css in the shipped tree; it is leftover, not part of the system.
Don't treat lib/projects.ts's image/icon emoji fields or gradient color strings as design-system material — neither is rendered anywhere; they are dead legacy data, not a glyph-icon or gradient rule.
